{{Quote|Dantooine is too remote to make an effective demonstration. But don't worry—we will deal with your Rebel friends soon enough.|[[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Dantooine''' {{Pronounced|'dæntuin}} was a pleasant world of pastel grasslands dotted with trees, rivers and lakes, located in the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] (at an endpoint of [[Myto's Arrow/Legends|Myto's Arrow]], the other endpoint being in the [[Obtrexta sector/Legends|Obtrexta sector]]); however, the planet itself was still rather far-removed from most [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] traffic. Dantooine was home to a small population of peaceful [[Human]] settlers, largely engaged in [[Farm|agriculture]] and inhabiting single-family dwellings within small communities, some with larger land holdings. In addition to Humans, Dantooine was also home to the endemic [[Dantari]], a primitive, slightly "brutish" (albeit physically imposing) race of tall, strong [[humanoid]] beings. Rich in both flora and fauna, animals of interest on Dantooine included the [[Kath hound/Legends|kath hound]], [[iriaz]], [[Kinrath/Legends|kinrath]] and [[Graul/Legends|graul]], among others, whose existence was largely due to Dantooine having no industrial or infrastructural establishments, nor anything resembling advanced technology, by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], save for a temporary [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Dantooine base/Legends|base]] there and a brief [[Jedi Enclave|Jedi enclave]] and training school.

==Description==
{{Quote|I mean, look at this planet – majestic fields, rolling plains, wide open terra firma. Elbow room – that's what people want.|[[Crattis Yurkal]]|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
A normal day on Dantooine lasted 25 standard hours, and a local year lasted 378 local days.
[[File:Dantooine_SoR.png|thumb|left|220px|A lone Rebel soldier speeds through the fields of Dantooine]]
Dantooine, early-on in its evolution, initially grew several large landmasses from its global seas, which would become the continents. There was an equatorial landmass connected to larger ones both to its north and south, conjoined by slender land bridges. There was also an insular northeastern continent.

An olive, blue, and brown-tinted world, Dantooine was removed from the hustle and bustle of the galactic trade routes. Two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] floated in the skies above the savannahs of lavender and yellow grasses.

Separated by forests of [[Blba tree/Legends|blba trees]], colonists maintained individual family estates largely isolated from each other.

One of the major continents of Dantooine was identified by its various geographical regions. To the southeast, there were the [[Rielig Steppes]], with the [[Burad Hills]] at their southeastern corner. The Northeast section was identified as the [[Fields of Banir]], which held the ruins of an ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] temple. To the Northwest, there were the [[Arissi Plains]], with the [[Mosa Rishin]] region and [[Taikaha Hills]] connecting to the southwestern [[Darjani Plains]].

==History==
===Infinite Empire===
The planet was one of the subject worlds of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. The Rakata built several structures on its surface; at least one of which housed a [[Star Map]] and several Rakata-made [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and was still standing by the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> Rakatan artifacts were still found scattered around the farmlands by the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]; [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces stationed on the planet were actively searching for them.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|Infinite History|Dantooine|type=daily}}</ref>

A theory persisted that the native [[Dantari]] were descended from a colonization attempt during the earliest days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], but no studies bore this supposition out, and the Dantari were recorded as being present since the beginning of more recent settlements.<ref name="atlas" />

===Old Sith Wars===
{{Quote|Even the Sith would think twice before attacking Dantooine. There are many Jedi here, including several of the most powerful masters of the order. There is great strength within this place.|[[Bastila Shan]]|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
[[File:Dantooine_conclave.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Jedi Enclave]]]]
During the [[Old Sith Wars]], the Galactic Republic began a full-scale colonization campaign on Dantooine. While the Republic by itself had virtually no military on the planet, the settlers were protected by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

By [[3997 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a Jedi training enclave was established by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]], although ruins of an even older Jedi structure could be found on the planet.<ref name="JATM" /> Many great Jedi of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] were trained on Dantooine. However, the Enclave on Dantooine was infamous for the number of its students who eventually fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]; among them were some of the greatest enemies of the Republic during that unstable period, such as [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]],<ref name="darklords1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]]</ref> [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], and [[Darth Malak|Malak]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

Forty years later, in [[3956 BBY]], the leading instructors at the Dantooine Jedi Enclave were Masters [[Vrook Lamar]], [[Zhar Lestin|Zhar]], [[Vandar Tokare]], and [[Dorak]]. When [[Bastila Shan]] brought a mentally dead Revan before the Dantooine council, they decided to give Revan another chance to redeem himself. Revan was trained there for a second time.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Just weeks after Revan completed his new training, the Enclave, along with many of Dantooine's other settlements, was [[Attack on Dantooine (Jedi Civil War)|destroyed]] by Darth Malak, who was obsessed with finding Revan and Bastila (Malak also took special care to bombard the ancient Rakatan temple to preserve the [[Star Forge]]'s secrecy, but by then it was too late).<ref name="KOTOR" /> This attack sent the Dantooine farming community into decay, as the Republic, weakened by the war, could not offer its support to the remote world. Until the collapse of the Sith Empire a year later, Dantooine was occupied by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], who executed almost all local leaders.<ref name="KOTORII">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

[[File:Dantooine.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Local Defense Grid]]
From 3956 to [[3951 BBY]], the settlers, led by Administrator [[Terena Adare]], began to rebuild their community by constructing the outpost of [[Khoonda]]. By then, Dantooine was populated by mercenaries and salvagers, the latter trying to make a living by finding Jedi relics from the ruined Enclave and selling them.<ref name="KOTORII" />

In 3951 BBY, the Republic nearly lost Dantooine to the Exchange, which planned to use the world as an outpost in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Exchange]] [[Azkul's mercenaries|mercenaries]] under the leadership of [[Azkul]], who where supported by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] under the leadership of [[Jana Lorso]], made trouble for the settlers, eventually culminating in the [[Battle of Khoonda]]. Thanks to the efforts of Master Vrook and [[Meetra Surik]], the meager Khoonda militia prevailed over Azkul's mercenaries and subsequently exiled the Exchange and Czerka Arms from the planet, and Dantooine remained in the Republic. The Republic eventually sent some of its forces to protect the battered planet.<ref name="KOTORII" />

After the battle, the Enclave was rebuilt and briefly became the residence of the reformed [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] (Master Vrook, Master [[Kavar]], and Master [[Zez-Kai Ell]]), but it was abandoned shortly after, when the Council members were killed by [[Kreia|Darth Traya]].<ref name="KOTORII" />

===Inter-Sith Wars period===
Following the destruction of the reformed Jedi Council, Dantooine once again faded into irrelevance. However, during the [[Third Galactic War]], the planet became hotly contested by the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] due to its strategic location at the edge of Imperial space. Around [[3627 BBY]], Dantooine was [[Dantooine Incursion|raided]] by the [[Nova Blades]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] covertly supported by the Sith Empire. The Empire used the Nova Blades as a distraction to infiltrate a small elite force in the surface and dispute the ground with Republic forces.<ref name="Marauders">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=event|The Marauders of Dantooine}}</ref>

In [[3622 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref>, a highly advanced research vessel [[Jannimak]], carrying many invasive animals and exotic plants [[Jannimak crash site|crashed on Dantooine]]. The ship's systems rapidly transformed the surrounding area into 3 environmental zones, suitable for the exotic life forms onboard, but highly hazardous to the native fauna. These zones were designated as "[[Glacial Trespass]]" - a habitat of extreme cold, "[[Geothermal Disruption]]" - a habitat of extremely high temperatures and "[[Sporefall]]" - a habitat with highly [[Mushroom/Legends|spore]]-active air, poisonous for most outsiders. Soon, [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] built a research camp nearby, from which its scientists could study the phenomena occurring in the environmental zones as well as the ship's response to any attempts of tempering with its systems. GSI employed various outsiders to perform hazardous tasks of collecting the needed data and defending scientists from the newly arrived predators.<ref name="Wreckage">{{TORcite|The Wreckage on Dantooine|Dantooine|exp=lots|type=general}}</ref> Another organization that showed interest in the situation was [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]], whose heavily-shielded personnel infiltrated the ship to steal the research data, however they were stopped by GSI's contractors.<ref name="CzerkaDaily">{{TORcite|Data Appropriation|Dantooine Crash Site Outpost|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref>

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Master Windu still fights on Dantooine.|Palpatine|<ref name="CW1">{{CW|1}}</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] won a widely publicized victory at the [[Battle of Dantooine (Clone Wars)|Battle of Dantooine]]. Although he was without his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] for much of the battle, Windu and a large [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] force defeated an army of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] and a massive [[Seismic tank/Legends|seismic tank]].<ref name="CW12">{{CW|12}}</ref><ref name="CW13">{{CW|13}}</ref>

The geneticist master [[Zeta Magnus]] held control over an accelerated [[GeNode]] facility on Dantooine during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Skyewalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>

===Galactic Empire===
{{Quote|X1 had killed Falon Grey, our genetic father, and left me for dead.|X2|<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>}}
At some time after the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] clone trooper [[X2]] aided the escaped [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Falon Grey]] in his [[Battle of Dantooine (Imperial Period)|battle]] against Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. While Grey fought with armed villagers, X2 moved around the Jedi Enclave. The two met in a mountain hangar, but X2's older brother [[X1]] arrived with his troops. Falon Grey defeated X1 in combat, but while at the lightsaber's edge, X1 killed the Jedi and incapacitated X2. X2 then lived on the planet for many years.

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|Our scout ships have reached Dantooine. They have found the remains of a Rebel base, but they estimate that it has been deserted for some time. They are now conducting an extensive search of the surrounding systems.|Siward Cass|audio=Cass-ANH.flac|<ref name="Episode 4" />}}
[[File:Dantooinelandscape.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A winding path on Dantooine]]
Years later, after the [[Corellian Treaty]] was signed, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] established Dantooine as their headquarters, establishing a [[Dantooine base/Legends|prefabricated base]] near the ruins of the old Jedi Enclave. The planet was also used as a staging post for [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] strikes—most famously, the [[Mission to Danuta|Battle of Danuta]], for the recovery of the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]].

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|special operative]] [[Jan Ors]] directed the seventeen-year-old [[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]] to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] her [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] carrying a cargo of stolen Imperial [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] [[Slug/Legends|slugs]] to the sanctuary of the Dantooine base, the first command center of the Rebel Alliance. Once arriving there, Datch began training as a starfighter pilot and officially joined the Rebellion.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was [[Assault on Kamino|captured]] by the Rebel Alliance on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and was taken hostage on Dantooine's Rebel base, unaware that [[Boba Fett/Legends|Fett]] was pursuing the Rebels and their valuable hostage in [[Slave I/Legends|his ship]]. Not long after, the Dantooine base was deserted after [[Ryle Torsyn/Legends|Ryle Torsyn]] discovered an Imperial [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] there, possibly placed by Boba Fett.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Ryle Torsyn}}</ref>

[[File:Dantoo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Dantooine farms]]
After the Alliance's relocation to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] tried to fool [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]] into believing that the main Rebel base was still located on Dantooine, attempting to spare her homeworld of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] from the destructive power of the Empire's newest weapon. Tarkin replied that Dantooine was too remote to use as an effective demonstration of the Death Star (the deciding factor here seemed to be a political and social impact rather than military necessity). Alderaan was destroyed and subsequently, Imperials did indeed discover the abandoned Rebel base. As Tarkin realized that Leia would lie to him even under the most dire circumstances, he ordered her execution.

The Empire took over the vacated Alliance base and discovered the Jedi cloning facility in the ruins, and resumed carrying out the research to develop rapid cloning procedures.<ref name="atlas" /> They also established an [[Imperial Outpost (Dantooine)|Imperial outpost]] and a [[Mining Outpost (Dantooine)|mining outpost]].<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies" />

Ex-Imperial Officer [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] also defected to the Rebel Alliance on this world. However, he was captured by the Imperial [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm Commando]] Corps. Before he was captured, he managed to send a panic-burst transmission to the orbiting members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] who immediately began a [[Mission to Dantooine|rescue operation]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] piloted a captured Imperial [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] to the landing zone, where he used several [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web]] repeating blasters to stop an Imperial [[Armored Personnel Carrier|APC]] which Tycho had been stored upon. After disabling the APC, Skywalker and Celchu used another two speeder bikes to escape from several waves of [[Probe droid/Legends|Probe droids]], APCs, enemy speeders and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa starfighters]]. However, upon arriving at the rendezvous point with [[Sarkli]], the Imperial forces had destroyed much of the Rebel task force, including several [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]], leaving four [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]], which the survivors used to escape. Upon reaching orbit, Celchu hemorrhaged information about trapped scientists on the planet [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]].

[[File:Dantooine-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A view of Dantooine]]
At some point during the Galactic Civil War, a [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Farstine)|bounty hunter]] and [[Unidentified child (Dantooine)|kid]] faced off against a [[Unidentified pirate (Dantooine)|pirate]] at Dantooine. The kid wrestled the pirate out of a hatch, forcing the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] to rescue him using an [[ablative heatshield]] and a [[Parachute/Legends|parachute]]. The bounty hunter dove from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] using the equipment to reach the surface of the planet.<ref name="TRG1-9">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Dantooine fell within the territory of the [[Pentastar Alignment]].<ref name="atlas" /> A cloaked stealth fighter was later taken from a museum on Dantooine by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and used by [[Lando's Commandos]] during a [[Mission to Radix|mission]] to [[Radix]].<ref name="Lando's Commandos">{{Tales|5|Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings}}</ref>

In the turbulent years following the reborn clone [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] resurrection, the New Republic relocated several refugees from [[Eol Sha]] to Dantooine. The colonist refugees did not have a chance to meet the native Dantari, since [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] dispatched an [[Maw fleet|Imperial]] force that massacred all the refugees.<ref name="Dark Apprentice">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
{{Quote|The lesson of Dantooine is a terrifying one. The Yuuzhan Vong care more about doing their duty than worrying about death.|Mara Jade Skywalker|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>}}
[[File:RetreatAtDantooine.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Dantooine is assaulted by the Yuuzhan Vong]]
Two months after the start of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] had landed on Dantooine with [[Anakin Solo]] to try to give Mara some rest from the war and to recover from her [[Coomb spore|sickness]]. There, the young Solo looked after his aunt, learned to rely on his physical strength rather than his power in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and befriended a native Dantari [[Tuber (Dantari)|man]]. However, the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] soon caught up with them, and New Republic Forces who were fleeing from [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]], including Leia Organa, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and [[Gavin Darklighter]], landed in another mess. Luke Skywalker and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] had arrived just moments earlier, and helped rescue Jade Skywalker and Anakin, who were nearly overtaken in their flight from the Yuuzhan Vong. They proceeded to fight in the [[Battle of Dantooine (Yuuzhan Vong War)|battle]] on the planet and aided in the Dubrillion refugees' escape.<ref name="Onslaught">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref> The population of the native Dantari were almost wiped out in the battle as the Yuuzhan Vong proceeded to conquer the planet. [[Kyp Durron]] later witnessed a two-kilometer-wide pit filled with the bones of those sacrificed to the [[Yun'o|Yuuzhan Vong gods]]. The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] reclaimed Dantooine when the Yuuzhan Vong surrendered.

===Post-Yuuzhan Vong War===
After the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the planet had come under the jurisdiction, of the [[Fel Empire]], [[44 ABY|four years later]]. After the rise of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] in [[130 ABY]], Dantooine was a member of the remnant of the Fel Empire, known as the [[Empire-in-exile|Empire in exile]]. In [[138 ABY]], when the Empire-in-exile had emerged with the [[New Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]], with the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|fall]] of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, Dantooine, presumably became a member of the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]].

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Dantooine in the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]].

In the PSP game ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'', Dantooine's landmasses are the island Ireland and part of Scotland repeated over the planet's sea.
